verdict.rationale: LangGraph's graph execution model supports parallelism and fan-out/fan-in patterns (Pregel/BSP-based orchestration for cycles and parallelism), which could theoretically be used to process many items concurrently, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk-operation, batch, or map-reduce API for acting on many items at once. missing for 10: explicit batch/map-over-items API, documented bulk-invoke or fan-out helper, first-party example of processing many items in one call.
